submitted_root_cause: Frontend is experiencing elevated p99 latency (1.83 seconds) and error rate (0.284%) due to application-level validation failures on POST /cart requests where required fields (Quantity, ProductID) are missing from incoming requests
submitted_action: Investigate client-side applications or API consumers sending POST /cart requests to ensure they include required fields (Quantity, ProductID). This is an application/API contract issue rather than an infrastructure problem requiring Kubernetes remediation.
